market_analysis.market_definition: The India Geospatial Analytics / GIS Market covers companies providing the following. Products and technology: Software: desktop GIS, web/mobile GIS, enterprise GIS; data: satellite, drone, LiDAR, IoT, demographic and cadastral data; technology: AI/ML, cloud, edge, GNSS. Services and business models: Software licensing/SaaS, data acquisition, geodatabase development, consulting and implementation, managed GIS services, custom application development. Applications: Urban planning, land administration, utilities, transportation, agriculture, environment, disaster management, defense, smart cities. End users: Government, utilities, telecom, construction, transportation, agriculture, mining, environmental agencies, enterprises. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player itself provides GIS and geospatial analytics solutions under its own name: desktop, web / mobile or enterprise GIS software, geospatial analytics platforms, geospatial data acquisition and geodatabase development, GIS consulting, implementation and managed GIS services, or custom geospatial applications. Diversified technology or engineering firms with a dedicated GIS / geospatial line qualify.
adjacent_segments: General IT services firms with no GIS / geospatial practice
Consumer navigation apps and consumer map content only
Survey hardware makers with no GIS software or analytics
Resellers of other vendors' GIS software only
